text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My first three years in the Twinkle Series
with
Mejiro Palmer are over. She's had
incredible
success during this time...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And as a result, she is gifted an equally
incredible
present for her efforts.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Now! To commemorate all of Mejiro
Palmer's
achievements...

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
A reward! This is a special gift from the
sponsors
behind the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Please be sure to deliver it to her
safely!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That is my mission from Director
Akikawa. The
question is, how should I
present it to her?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh crap! I'm sooo late! Why today of all
days?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Where's Trainer? There's no way I can
get away
with being this late scot-free...
Hang on, I don't
see Trainer anywhere...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
No way... Am I not the only one who's
late?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Nah, that can't be it. Something must've
come
up...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: B-beep!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Eeep! Sorry! I'll get outta the... H-huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vrooooom...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I show Mejiro Palmer a good time with a
long
drive along the coast.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
This is totally awesome! Put that pedal
to the
metal! Woohoo! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She shrieks with joy and laughter as the
wind
whips through her hair.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fshhh, fshhh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whew, we're pretty far out. Driving
around
without a destination in mind is
pretty awesome,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Once in a while, I just wanna break away
from the
daily grind and do whatever I
feel like doing,
y'know? ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that's true. I've been doing
nothing but running away from my tiny,
insignificant self and
the path that was
decided for me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
And now, I've finally got this far and
found some
confidence. Thanks to that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah... The breeze feels so good. I'm not
scared of
anything anymore!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Well, I wasted a lot of time fidgeting at
the
starting line and took forever to get
out the gate
till you showed up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I started living up my life later
than
everyone else, but...
choice_data_list: Still, you caught up with that sec...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's never too late to change! Whatever I
might
not have now, I can still get my
hands on in the
future!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of things she might not have
yet, now
might be the time to give her
one such thing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
For me? What is it? Something really
hype?
choice_data_list: By the way, there's something I wa...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I turn her to face the car we drove to get
out
here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You mean... the rental car? Are you
asking me to
drive us back?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! No way, are you messing with
me?!
What are you talking about?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain that the sponsors of the
Twinkle Series decided to reward her
with a car to celebrate her
victories and
achievements.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
A trophy car... Then, that really is mine
now...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean I can do whatever with
it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
YAAAY! This is the bestest thing ever!
Now we
can go wherever, whenever!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
We've hit the all-you-can-drive lottery,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I nod, but there's something I can't help
asking
her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, well, I didn't do this all on my own,
so I
thought we should share the prize.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
By the way, could you give the car a
name,
please?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I wanna use it for a long, long
time, so make it a name I won't get
bored of. Y'know,
something we can
really treasure.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Something that reflects the value of her 
accomplishments...  A name worth
treasuring...
Only one option comes to
mind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait, but that's...
choice_data_list: Then let's take the Mejiro Palmer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hold up... That's what you think we
should
treasure?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Okay. Let's roll with that. I do
like keepin'
things simple.
choice_data_list: Yeah, and it's also a commemoratio...
Yeah, it's to commemorate those ac...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the Mejiro Palmer! I knew there's
nothing I
can't get my hands on!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A satisfied grin for the ages spreads
across her
face. That's pure joy if I've
ever seen it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: A car... Maybe, yeah? But...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
There're a lot of other things I want. But
for now, I
wanna take the Mejiro Palmer
out for a spin!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: C'mon, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer might've had a late start,
but she
caught up in the blink of an eye
and is now
pushing to the front.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vrooooom!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Faster, Trainer, faster! To the limits!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Woohoo! Freedom is the bestest ever!
Go, Mejiro
Palmer, gooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: VROOOOOM!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Mejiro Palmer pumps out even more
speed. Once, she might have been a
runaway who got a
late start and whom
nobody knew...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But now, she's running far, far ahead of
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's leading the way on a path no one
knew even
existed, all while leaving her
mark as the freest
Mejiro of all time.
